## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Update the stale `make test` instruction in AGENTS.md. After this rename, the repository's only pre-push check points to a Makefile target that no longer exists.

## Changes
The PR renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README to say `make check`. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists the repository files and Makefile targets.

Following it now fails with make's "No rule to make target 'test'". The Layout section added in this PR names `check` as the target, so the two parts of AGENTS.md now disagree. — Anyone following the guide has no working test command, and AGENTS.md:26 says these commands are the only checks a change gets. — Fix: Change `make test` to `make check` at `AGENTS.md:24`.
